QUOTE: So an allow entry only skips prompting. The deny list is enforced later, inside `ServerManager::execute`, so deny still wins even when `auto_approve` is true or the tool is allow-listed.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the allow list only skips prompting (approval), consulted via `check_approval` in tool_executor.cpp, while enforcement of deny happens separately in server_manager.cpp.
